harness.help: Build packages of the skills and agents for other harnesses (Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode).
harness.export.help: Write the package files of one harness into a directory (nothing is installed).
harness.export.target: Harness to build the package for.
harness.export.out: Directory to write the package into.
harness.export.wev: Absolute path of the wev launcher the hooks and skills call (default: this clone's bin/wev).
harness.error.unknown_target: Unknown harness target {target}; use one of: {targets}.
harness.error.wev_missing: The wev launcher {path} does not exist.
harness.skipped.codex_agents: subagents not exported for codex: format unknown (the note does not say which directory Codex scans for [agents.<role>] files)
harness.skipped.codex_trust: codex hooks: not marked trusted; Codex runs an unreviewed hook only after one trust review (how to write the trusted hash is unknown)
harness.skipped.agent_tools: agent frontmatter tools and model omitted for {target}: the spec uses Claude Code tool names and tiers, and their {target} equivalents are not documented in the note
harness.skipped.gemini_context: gemini contextFileName: no context file is shipped, so it is left out
harness.error.not_empty: The export directory {path} is not empty; use an empty or new directory.
harness.skipped.gemini_hooks_shape: gemini hooks/hooks.json: the top-level {"hooks": ...} wrapper is inferred from the settings.json form (the only form the note documents), and whether extension hooks need folder trust is unknown; no support is claimed until the end-to-end run
harness.install.help: Install the wev package into a harness (codex, gemini, opencode) and record what was written in a manifest.
harness.uninstall.help: Undo harness install: unregister and remove only the files the manifest lists.
harness.install.target: Harness to install into (codex, gemini, opencode).
harness.install.wev: Absolute path of the wev launcher the hooks and skills call (default: this clone's bin/wev).
harness.uninstall.target: Harness to uninstall from (codex, gemini, opencode).
harness.error.not_installable: Cannot install into {target}: use codex, gemini or opencode.
harness.error.placeholder: Refusing to install {path}: it is a placeholder (first line // wev-placeholder), not a shipped feature.
harness.error.not_installed: Nothing to uninstall: no manifest for {target}.
harness.next.codex_trust: Codex runs an unreviewed hook only after you trust it: start codex and review and trust the wev-skills hooks when it asks. Until then the guard hooks do not run.
harness.next.codex_check: Check the skills are visible with: codex debug prompt-input
harness.error.manifest_invalid: The manifest {path} is not valid ({why}); nothing was run or removed. Delete the file or fix it, then retry.
harness.error.symlink: Refusing to write the package: {path} is a symlink or outside the directory it must stay in. Remove it and retry.
harness.error.manifest_write: The manifest could not be written ({error}); the registrations were undone.
harness.error.undo_previous: Could not undo the previous install ({command} failed); it was left in place. Run uninstall again once the harness command works.
harness.error.copy_failed: Could not copy {path} into the package ({error}); the files copied so far were removed.
harness.next.gemini_restart: Gemini loads the extension only after a restart: start gemini again. The link keeps pointing at this package, so do not move it.
harness.next.gemini_check: Check the extension is registered with: gemini extensions list -o json
harness.next.gemini_link: Link the extension yourself, in your terminal, so you see and answer its security warning (wev does not accept it for you): {command}
harness.error.opencode_conflict: Refusing to overwrite {path}: wev did not create it. Move or rename it, then retry.
harness.next.opencode_restart: OpenCode loads plugins, skills and agents at startup: start opencode again.
harness.next.opencode_check: Check the skills with the opencode skill tool, and that plugins/wev-guard.js is in your OpenCode config directory. The guard plugin has not been run inside a real OpenCode yet.
